data.title: Coordinated Bust-Out Timing — Simultaneous Max-Utilization Across Multiple Products
data.description: Detects coordinated bust-out execution where the same identity (or linked identities) max out credit across multiple products within a 72-hour window. Synthetic identity rings time their bust-out to extract maximum value before accounts are frozen: cash advances, balance transfers to controlled accounts, and high-value purchases for resale all occur within a narrow window. When 3+ credit products associated with the same identity show utilization above 90% within 72 hours, and at least one involves a cash advance or balance transfer, this is a high-confidence bust-out indicator.

detection.condition: count(distinct account_id) by identity_id >= 3 AND selection_high_utilization AND at least one selection_cash_advance within timeframe

queries.cql:
// CrowdStrike CQL for Coordinated Bust-Out Timing
// Detects 3+ products maxed within 72h for same identity
current_utilization_pct>=90
| groupBy(identity_id, function=[
    count(field=account_id, distinct=true, as=products_maxed),
    sum(transaction_amount, as=total_exposure),
    collect([account_id, transaction_type, transaction_amount,
             credit_limit, current_utilization_pct, merchant_category])
  ], span=72h)
| products_maxed >= 3
| has_cash_advance := transaction_type=/CASH_ADVANCE|BALANCE_TRANSFER|CONVENIENCE_CHECK/
| sort(total_exposure, order=desc)
queries.splunk:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Coordinated Bust-Out Timing")`
`comment("Detects 3+ products maxed within 72h for same identity")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:transaction_monitoring
  current_utilization_pct>=90
| stats dc(account_id) AS products_maxed,
        sum(transaction_amount) AS total_exposure,
        values(account_id) AS accounts,
        values(transaction_type) AS txn_types,
        values(merchant_category) AS merchants,
        max(credit_limit) AS max_limit
  BY identity_id _time span=72h
| where products_maxed >= 3
| search txn_types="*CASH_ADVANCE*" OR txn_types="*BALANCE_TRANSFER*"
    OR txn_types="*CONVENIENCE_CHECK*"
| eval risk = if(products_maxed >= 5, "critical",
              if(total_exposure > 100000, "critical", "high"))
| table identity_id, products_maxed, total_exposure, accounts,
        txn_types, merchants, risk
| sort - total_exposure
queries.sql:
-- SQL for Coordinated Bust-Out Timing
-- Detects 3+ products maxed within 72h for same identity
WITH maxed_products AS (
  SELECT
    t.identity_id,
    t.account_id,
    t.transaction_type,
    t.transaction_amount,
    a.credit_limit,
    a.current_utilization_pct,
    t.transaction_date
  FROM transactions t
  JOIN credit_accounts a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
  WHERE a.current_utilization_pct >= 90
    AND t.transaction_date >= DATEADD(HOUR, -72, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
)
SELECT
  identity_id,
  COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) AS products_maxed,
  SUM(transaction_amount) AS total_exposure,
  STRING_AGG(DISTINCT transaction_type, ', ') AS txn_types,
  MAX(CASE WHEN transaction_type IN ('CASH_ADVANCE', 'BALANCE_TRANSFER', 'CONVENIENCE_CHECK')
      THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_cash_advance
FROM maxed_products
GROUP BY identity_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) >= 3
   AND MAX(CASE WHEN transaction_type IN ('CASH_ADVANCE', 'BALANCE_TRANSFER', 'CONVENIENCE_CHECK')
           THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1
ORDER BY total_exposure DESC

references: Federal Reserve, Synthetic Identity Fraud in the U.S. Payment System (2024)
Aite-Novarica, Synthetic Identity Fraud: Coordinated Bust-Out Patterns (2025)
falsepositives: Consumers aggressively using multiple cards for large planned purchases (rare)
Business owners using multiple personal cards for business expenses during cash flow crunch
